title: Laddu, Chintu and the Day-Forever Lanterns
moral: Let the night stay dark and quiet, so every animal can rest.
description: The sun is going down in Masti Nagar, but Laddu and Chintu don't want their cricket game to end! Can Chintu's wobbly plans turn night into day? Learn about day and night, the sun, the moon and the stars with Laddu, Chintu, Dadaji and Golu the goat in this funny animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.
outro: Remember, friends: let the night stay dark and quiet, so every animal can rest! And Golu says... the lanterns were yummy! Ba-a-a-a! See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

narration.text: Cock-a-doodle-DOO! Good morning, friends! The big orange sun popped up over Masti Nagar!
When the sun comes up, it is DAY! The sky turns bright and blue, and everybody wakes up.
Well... almost everybody. SNORE! Laddu was still fast asleep!

narration.text: Day time? Arre wah... is it jalebi time?

narration.text: All day long, the friends played cricket in the lane. Laddu was the batsman!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Ready, Laddu? Here comes my super-fast ball!
Laddu swung his bat... WHOOSH! He spun round and round like a spinning top!
And the ball? BOING! Golu caught it... in his mouth!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
In the DAY, we play, we learn and we work. What do YOU like to do in the day?
Play? Go to school? Wonderful!

popups.sub: day is for play and learning

narration.text: Slowly, slowly, the sun went down... down... down. The sky turned pink and orange.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Nooo! Come back, sun! We haven't finished our game!
Friends, when the sun goes down, what comes next? Is it day... or night?
NIGHT! You're so clever! At night, the sky gets dark.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! We'll push the sun back up with this long bamboo stick!
They pushed and pushed... BONK! The stick bounced off the banyan tree and a big leaf landed SPLAT on Chintu's glasses!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Don't worry, I have a plan... a slightly wobbly plan! Let's WAKE the sun with a big noise!
Laddu banged a pot. CLANG! Chintu tooted a trumpet. HONK!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
But the sun did not come back. Of course not, silly! The sun comes back in the MORNING.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Plan number three! If we can't have the sun... we'll MAKE the day! With lanterns and lamps!

narration.text: Then, jingle-jangle, along came Dadaji in his sleepy pyjamas.

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Arre! Who turned the night into day? And where are my glasses? I can't see a thing!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Dadaji... your glasses are on your HEAD!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! So they are! Children, the day is for playing. The night is for resting. The birds and the cows need the dark to sleep.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Oh no... we kept them awake. Sorry, little birds!
So they switched off the lamps, one by one. Then Laddu blew on the last lantern. PHOOOOOO!
He blew so hard that Chintu's glasses flew off... and landed on Golu's nose! Professor Golu!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
Then everything was dark and quiet. Look up, friends! What can you see in the night sky?
The MOON and the twinkly STARS! Wah!
Hoo-hoo! A little owl opened her big round eyes. Owls wake up at night!
Back home, the friends looked up at the quiet, starry sky. Let's remember!
What shines in the sky in the DAY?
The SUN! Super!
And what shines in the sky at NIGHT?
The MOON and the stars! You're all superstars!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO... now, everyone... time to... zzzz... I'm awake! I was just resting my eyes!

narration.text: Cock-a-doodle-DOO! The sun came up again, all by itself. A brand-new DAY!
The birds woke up fresh and happy. Tweet-tweet! Thank you for the quiet night!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Good morning, Laddu! See? The sun came back without any pushing!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Wah! Now that it's day... is it jalebi time?
And Golu? He was munching the paper lanterns for breakfast! Crunch, crunch!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
